Notes: All 4 disagreements came from the gap definition: 1-2 month dips (suite2p, pinocchio, agnwinds) and the non-codebook value 'Partly' (ketch). Resolved by agreeing that any zero-commit month is a gap and any later commit counts as recovery. esri was also revised from No to Yes under that rule.

All 3 disagreements followed from HasRecovered (validator N/A vs author narrative) and were resolved by keeping the author's text once those projects counted as recovered. Free-text values elsewhere agreed in substance despite different wording.

3 of 4 disagreements involved 'cyclical'. No series showed fixed-interval repetition (lag-12 autocorrelation 0.13 or lower), so the author's labels were kept. fhir-server steady vs irregular was settled by its low month-to-month variation (CV 0.41).
All 5 disagreements came from one terminology issue: the validator read the Coding Guide's 2025-09-30 reference date as a typo for 2026. Agreeing to use the date as written resolved all 5 to Active.

Disagreements came from counting commits differently: PR descriptions vs commit messages (pytransit, fhir-server) and whether Dependabot merges are bot contributions or dependency updates (pinocchio, resolved as a compromise).
